ng.definition: Adjusted EBITDA = operating income after eliminating (i) depreciation, amortisation and impairment charges (net of reversals) on non-current assets; (ii) non-recurring income and expenses presented under Other income / Other expenses; (iii) items that do not reflect core operating performance (business reorganisation and adaptation costs, acquisition costs, IFRS 2 share-based payments). Adjusted EBIT = operating income after (ii) and (iii), excluding the D&A of the portion of non-current assets that corresponds to purchase price allocations.

extra.guidance: Outlook for 2026 (URD 2025, p.208): revenue in the range of EUR 520m–540m; adjusted EBITDA in the range of EUR 168m–178m; capital expenditure around 9% of 2026 revenue (excluding capitalized R&D expenses, expected at around 3% of revenue). New medium-term outlook: average annual organic revenue growth up to mid-teens; average annual organic adjusted EBITDA growth above 15% (mild progressive margin improvement); normalized capex around 5% of revenue after completion of the current capacity expansion by 2027 (plus capitalized R&D ~3%); targeted, value-creating acquisitions with the ambition of reaching EUR 1bn revenue; net debt / adjusted EBITDA may temporarily rise to around 2x; dividend payout ratio 20–25% of net income. The Group does not provide profit forecasts.
